Fictional illustrative art, not a real merchant photo or testimonial.

Specific scene: Tender detailed watercolor-and-gouache illustration of an Indonesian mother who owns a small bakery, finally sitting with tea while her adult daughter takes over tying boxes at the nearby counter. They share a relaxed glance. Morning pastries, soft window light, aprons and lived-in business details, respectful capable women, no flowers-as-default or holiday lettering.
